bear-mountain-and-hudson-highlands.title: Bear Mountain and Hudson Highlands
bear-mountain-and-hudson-highlands.slogan: A 191 km loop out of Palisades Parkway north
bear-mountain-and-hudson-highlands.story: The city drops away, the river opens up. Out of Riverdale and back again: 191 km, roughly 3 h 18 in the saddle.
